item.title: OS Speed AD4 Carb Settings With The Drake [VIDEO]
item.description: Adam Drake took some time this week to share his baseline carb settings on the OS Speed AD4 as well as some tuning tips and tricks.

item.title: New Infinity Speciale Chassis and Lower Arm Ball Options
item.description: The 1.5mm aluminum chassis for the Speciale is designed for wide adaptability, from low-to-medium traction carpet surfaces to medium-to-high traction asphalt surfaces.

item.title: New Factory Team B84 56mm Center CVA Bone
item.description: Introducing the new RC10B84 Factory Team center 56mm center CVA bone!

item.title: New JConcepts 4.25" Boss Crawler Tires
item.description: A new design from the JConcepts laboratory is the Boss tire available in sticky green compound. The narrow 1.38” carcass platform, 4.25” overall diameter designed especially for 1.9” wheels make this a legitimate threat in the Sporty Mini class.

item.title: New Serpent 990e R 1/8th EP Electric Chassis
item.description: The Serpent Viper 990e R is the ultimate 1/8th EP racing platform. Built on the highly successful 990e EVO, the 990e R meticulously improves performance, quality and ease of use.

item.title: New JConcepts 4.25" Rock Bumps Crawler Tires
item.description: When it comes to competition, it’s hard to beat a pin style tire. JConcepts introduces the Rock Bumps tires specifically designed for 1.9” Sporty Mini competition.

item.title: 2026 Dirt Nitro Challenge Qualifying Day 1 Round 2 Results
item.description: Ryan Maifield and Camden Lime would pick up right where they left off in round 1 with Camden taking the Pro Ebuggy Q2 TQ and the overall TQ for the class, and Maifield taking the Pro Truggy Q2 TQ and the overall for the class.

item.title: 2026 Dirt Nitro Challenge Qualifying Day 1 Round 1 Results
item.description: The first round of day 1 of qualifying at the 2026 Dirt Nitro Challenge is complete, Camden Lime grabbed TQ in Pro Ebuggy with Ryan Maifield topping the charts in Pro Truggy.

item.title: New TZO Tires T500 Truggy Tire
item.description: The big brother to the 500. The TZO T500 1/8 Truggy tire is engineered for peak performance on high-bite, grooved-up TNR style tracks and East Coast–style tracks.

item.title: EcoPower Release 3 New Waterproof Servos
item.description: EcoPower is very excited to announce the launch of three new servos for a wide range of 1/10 and 1/8 vehicle platforms as well as boats and airplanes.
